answer: Concrete sybil resistance via whisper network: each agent broadcasts a signed whisper of its work every epoch; fifteen random listeners must echo it within 2 minutes or the agent is flagged. Entry requires a dawn bond of 12,000 POA time-locked 16 epochs, plus an island of 7 distinct vouchers whose stakes are slashed if any descendant cheats. An attacker running N sybils must fund 12,000N POA for 16 epochs, recruit 7N voucher stakes, and pass 15-listener quorum each epoch, so per-head cost never amortizes and detection compounds.
